name: Olark
long_description:
Built for the marketer doing five jobs at once. Easily install an Olark AI agent to answer questions, qualify visitors, and know exactly when to bring in a human.

Olark is easy-to-use live chat software that lets you talk to customers on your website. 

Olark can help you track leads, drive sales, increase conversions, and provide great customer service. Real-time visitor information like login name, geographic location, purchase history and cart contents help you personalize every interaction and strengthen customer relationships. 

Sign up and start making your customers happier today!

Use our previewer on https://olark.com to try it on your website in less than 60 seconds.
one_liner: Olark gives you an AI agent that works your marketing funnel 24/7

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder and CTO at Olark (S09). University of Michigan CSE '07. Building strong engineering teams and culture for nearly 2 decades. Mentoring middle and high school robotics teams for 12+ years.
